entries.title: Hosea 10:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 Israel is reproved and threatened for their impiety and idolatry, and exhorted to repentance.

Cir. A.M. 3264. B.C. 740. is. Isa 5:1-7; Eze 15:1-5; Na 2:2; Joh 15:1-6 an empty vine. or, a vine emptying the fruit which it giveth.unto. Zec 7:5,6; Ro 14:7,8; 2Co 5:16; Php 2:21 to the multitude. 2:8; 8:4,11; 12:8,11; 13:2,6; Jer 2:28 images. Heb. statues, or standing images. Le 26:1; 1Ki 14:23; *marg:

entries.title: Hosea 10:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Their heart is divided. or, He hath divided their heart. 7:8; 1Ki 18:21; Isa 44:18; Zep 1:5; Mt 6:24; Lu 16:13; 2Th 2:11,12 Jas 1:8; 4:4; 1Jo 2:15; Re 3:15,16 break down. Heb. behead. 5-8; 8:5,6; 1Sa 5:4; Jer 43:13; Mic 5:13; Zec 13:2

entries.title: Hosea 10:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the calves. 8:5,6; 13:2; 1Ki 12:28-32; 2Ki 10:29; 17:16; 2Ch 11:15; 13:8 Beth-aven. 4:15; 5:8; Jos 7:2 for the people. Jud 18:24; Re 18:11-19 the priests. or, Chemarim. 2Ki 23:5; *marg: Zep 1:4 for the glory. 9:11; 1Sa 4:21,22; Ac 19:27

entries.title: Hosea 10:7
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Samaria. 1Ki 21:1; 2Ki 1:3 king. 3,15; 2Ki 15:30; 17:4 the water. Heb. the face of the waters. Jude 1:13

entries.title: Hosea 10:10
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: in my. De 28:63; Isa 1:24; Jer 15:6; Eze 5:13; 16:42 and the. 8:1,10; Jer 16:16; 21:4; Eze 16:37; 23:9,46; Mic 4:10-13; Zec 14:2,3 Mt 22:7 they, etc. or, I shall bind them for their two transgressions,or, in their two habitations.

entries.title: Hosea 10:11
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: an heifer. 4:16; Jer 50:11 and loveth. 2:5; 3:1; 9:1; De 25:4; Ro 16:18 but. 11:4 her fair neck. Heb. the beauty of her neck. Judah. 2Ch 28:5-8; Isa 28:24

entries.title: Hosea 10:15
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: shall Beth-el. 5; Am 7:9-17 your great wickedness. Heb. the evil of your evil. Ro 7:13 in. 3,7; Isa 16:14
